reviews.text: Staff goes above and beyond. Prices are reasonable, communication is great and they got the job done in a timely fashion!
reviews.author: Ross M.

reviews.text: Thoroughly professional. They're oil change includes a checklist as long as your arm. Always very personable and pleasant to work with. They let you know exactly what's going on, how much it'll cost, etc. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Brian B.

reviews.text: First time coming to CJ's and the service was excellent! Mel was extremely helpful and friendly and gave updates along the way! The prices are great for the new tires and oil change i got. I will definitely being using CJ's for my service needs going forward!
reviews.author: Mike R.
